title: SyscallRecord
description: Standardized schema for single host syscall event emitted by Person A (eBPF collector or trace replay) and consumed by Person B (host detector) and Person C/D (evaluation/harness).

timestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in seconds (microsecond or nanosecond floating precision).

pid.description: Process ID of the emitting process.

ppid.description: Parent Process ID (extracted via task->real_parent->tgid or trace context).

uid.description: User ID executing the syscall (0 indicates root).

comm.description: Executable command name (Linux TASK_COMM_LEN, max 16 chars from kernel, or trace identifier).

syscall.description: Canonical Linux syscall name (e.g. openat, execve, connect, ptrace, init_module, mount).

ret.description: Syscall return value (0 for success, negative POSIX errno for failure in trace/exit probes).

stage_id.description: Evaluation metadata: MITRE kill-chain stage ID (e.g. stage_1_dropper, stage_2_injection). Person D harness annotation.

mitre_technique.description: Evaluation metadata: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID (e.g. T1055.008, T1547.006). Person D harness annotation.

is_attack.description: Ground truth binary indicator for offline evaluation.

blindness_rationale.description: Evaluation metadata explaining why network-only sensors fail on this event.

owner_consumes: Person B (Detection — detection/host_features.py), Person C (ATT&CK Mapper), Person D (Harness)
